services.value: Florida-Spectrum Environmental Services provides environmental testing and analytical chemistry, including analysis of groundwater, surface water, drinking water, soil, hazardous wastes, and other sample matrices. It also offers full service laboratory capabilities such as Atomic Absorption, ICP, Ion Chromatography, Gas Chromatography, Mass Spectrometry, Microbiology, Radiochemistry, Wet Chemistry, plus field services like sampling supplies delivery/certified field technicians and courier services.
